Third-party libraries used by the monthly report export (loaded only when you click Download):

- pptxgen.bundle.js: PptxGenJS 3.12.0 (MIT) https://github.com/gitbrent/PptxGenJS
- html2canvas-pro.min.js: html2canvas-pro 1.5.8 (MIT) https://github.com/yorickshan/html2canvas-pro
- jspdf.umd.min.js: jsPDF 2.5.1 (MIT) https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF
- NotoSans-ReportText.ttf: Noto Sans Regular, subset to Latin, Greek, Cyrillic, punctuation and currency symbols (SIL Open Font License 1.1, see NotoSans-OFL.txt) https://github.com/notofonts/latin-greek-cyrillic. Used for the selectable text layer in Custom Report Builder PDFs.
- NotoSansKannada-ReportText.ttf and NotoSansMalayalam-ReportText.ttf: Noto Sans Kannada / Malayalam Regular, subset to their scripts (SIL Open Font License 1.1, see NotoSansKannada-OFL.txt and NotoSansMalayalam-OFL.txt) https://github.com/notofonts/kannada and https://github.com/notofonts/malayalam. Used for Kannada and Malayalam in the PDF text layer.
- NotoSans{Devanagari,Bengali,Gurmukhi,Gujarati,Oriya,Tamil,Telugu,Arabic,OlChiki,MeeteiMayek}-ReportText.ttf: Noto Sans (and Noto Naskh Arabic, saved as NotoSansArabic-ReportText.ttf) subset to each script (SIL Open Font License 1.1, see NotoSans-Indian-scripts-OFL.txt) https://github.com/notofonts. Used for those scripts in the PDF text layer.
